limitations.classification: eth_getCode at latest block — point-in-time; a contract can self-destruct and an EOA can later gain code.
limitations.direct_recipient_plausibility: Derived only from EOA/contract classification; a contract may still be a valid recipient via an application-specific path not evaluated here.
limitations.freshness: Reflects chain state at checked_at; may be served from cache up to freshness_bound_seconds.
limitations.proxy_indication: Detects ONLY EIP-1967 (standard implementation slot) and EIP-1167 (minimal-proxy bytecode). Legacy zeppelinos-slot, other-slot UUPS, and diamond proxies read as none_detected.
limitations.scope: does not assess token behavior allowlisting, blocklist state, contract withdrawal authority, or future release success
limitations.transfer_path: eth_call simulation at latest block, not an on-chain transfer. A revert may be caused by token blocklist state, a paused token, or non-standard ERC-20 logic; the reason string is reported verbatim — blocklist detection is NOT claimed as a feature.

note: This preview always evaluates a fixed demo address (REV, a real Base EOA) so you can see the response format and verify the signature. To check an address of your choice, GET /payable/address?address=<0x..>&chain=base. Strip preview, demo_address, input_ignored, note (plus signature, signed_by) before verifying.
